name: Elimelech
title: Naomi's husband from Bethlehem
summary: Elimelech was a man from Bethlehem in Judah who emigrated to Moab with his wife Naomi and their two sons due to famine in Israel. His death in Moab left Naomi as a widow in a foreign land, which eventually led her to return to Bethlehem with her daughter-in-law Ruth.

keyEvents.title: Emigration to Moab
keyEvents.description: Due to famine in Judah, Elimelech left Bethlehem with his family and settled in Moab.

keyEvents.title: Elimelech's death in Moab
keyEvents.description: Elimelech died in Moab, leaving Naomi alone with her two sons in a foreign land.

keyEvents.title: The legacy of Elimelech
keyEvents.description: Elimelech's plot of land near Bethlehem was later redeemed by Boaz as the kinsman-redeemer, which secured the family's inheritance and name.
